analytics.description: Track local Codex JSONL usage by project, session, hour, and prompt.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure startup, tray usage display mode, and theme.

launchAtStartup.label: Launch at startup
launchAtStartup.description: Automatically start CodexTool when you log in.

launchCodexAfterSwitch.label: Launch Codex after switch
launchCodexAfterSwitch.description: Enabled by default. When disabled, only switch account without launching Codex.

smartSwitchIncludeApi.label: Include API in smart switch (when signed-in accounts run out of quota)

syncOpencode.label: Sync Opencode OpenAI auth
syncOpencode.description: Auto-detect opencode auth file and sync refresh/access on switch.

restartEditorsOnSwitch.label: Restart editors on switch (Codex plugin compatible)
restartEditorsOnSwitch.description: Disabled by default. When enabled, selected editors are force-restarted on account switch.

settings.noSupportedEditors: No supported editor detected for restart.

trayUsageDisplay.label: Status bar display
trayUsageDisplay.description: Choose whether the status bar shows used quota, remaining quota, 5h remaining only, 1-week remaining only, or hides usage.

windowsTrayIconStyle.label: Quota icon style
windowsTrayIconStyle.description: Choose a compact icon based on remaining quota, or hide the quota icon.

macosQuotaOnboardingPreview.label: First-launch quota setup preview (Debug)
macosQuotaOnboardingPreview.description: Reopens the real setup without clearing account data or changing the app identity.

windowsTaskbarWidget.label: Windows taskbar quota component (Experimental)
windowsTaskbarWidget.description: Shows the CodexTool icon before the quota, matching the macOS status bar. Its transparent background exposes the taskbar's real color, gradient, and material.
windowsTaskbarWidget.groupAriaLabel: Windows primary taskbar quota component placement

windowsWidgets.disableAriaLabel: Open Windows taskbar settings to turn off the weather widget
windowsWidgets.openFailed: Unable to open Windows taskbar settings.
